verdict.rationale: Skyvern's docs say self-hosted deployments use your own LLM API keys or a local model, and organizations can set models. Supporting local models alongside hosted keys shows it is not locked to one vendor. A community user's OpenAI bill confirms that bring-your-own-key works in practice. Missing for 10: an explicit list of supported LLM providers (e.g. OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure, open-source), documentation of how to configure or switch providers, and confirmation that bring-your-own-model applies on the cloud offering and not only self-hosted.
